facts.value: On successful custom-ECB continuation, restores saved facing before entering ftCo_MS_JumpB at frame 0/rate 1, calls ftColl_8007B6EC, clears jump x0/x4 and sets jump_mul=1. Final X velocity is retained X times ground_to_air_jump_momentum_multiplier plus -facing_dir*x78*jump_h_initial_velocity, capped by the strict ABS(sum)>jump_h_max_velocity test. This is a conventional bound only for finite nonnegative tuning, and retained momentum can preserve a forward final velocity. Final Y is jump_v_initial_velocity, overwriting the earlier x438 multiplication; Z is zero. It then initializes item impact and requests effect, quake and fighter feedback.

facts.value: Resolves Fighter from gobj. Common x694 and x698 feed ftCommon_Fall, which subtracts gravity and applies a strict lower clamp to self_vel.y. For s=input.lstick[0].x, computes accel=s*warpstarfall_drift_scaling+(s>0 ? warpstarfall_drift_flat : -warpstarfall_drift_flat) and target=s*warpstarfall_drift_max. ftCommon_8007D174 receives current self_vel.x, accel, target and x6A8 as friction; nonzero-target processing writes x74_anim_vel.x rather than directly replacing self_vel.x. Zero target delegates to aerial friction, so neutral input's negative flat term does not by itself create leftward drift. No local finite-value validation is performed.

facts.rationale: Replace imprecise reaching-boundary summary with complete verified lifecycle and ownership sequencing.
facts.value: WarpStarJump initializes a 120-count timer and zero root-translation history. Its animation callback decrements first and enters WarpStarFall when Y strictly exceeds Stage_GetBlastZoneTopOffset or the decremented count equals zero; boundary equality alone does not transition. Fall begins at saved starting X, current top-offset Y and zero Z, allows stick-controlled drift through common physics, and tests an item-scaled ECB. Successful non-vetoed collision restores saved facing before entering JumpB and reusing jump motion variables, initializes rebound velocity, activates item impact and requests feedback. Both ride entries install damage/death cleanup wrappers; these restore facing and invoke item dropped handling without their own transition or once-only guard. Timer duration is established in callback invocations, not wall-clock time.

facts.rationale: Add first-sample invariant and exceptional-value boundary to the existing root-motion description.
facts.value: Each invocation unconditionally replaces self_vel with current root-JObj translation minus mv.co.warpstar.self_vel, then saves the current translation in that history field. Entry initializes the history to zero, so the first sample is measured against zero rather than against an entry-time root sample. All three axes are processed; there is no timestep division, finite-value check or local state transition.
